summary: Frontend-only testing of Students bulk-actions feature (multi-select, bulk status/visibility/delete, role gating). Every core UI behavior specified in the review request works end-to-end.

super_admin.card_view_checkbox_no_navigation: PASS - clicking st-card-select-<id> toggles selection and keeps URL at /students (no navigation to detail).
super_admin.bulk_bar_appears_with_count: PASS - students-bulk-bar shows '1 selected', updates to '3 selected' after select-all.
super_admin.list_view_select_all: PASS - students-select-all checks all visible rows (3 ZZ test rows selected).
super_admin.bulk_status_change: PASS - bulk-status-select 'Enrolled' -> success toast, selection cleared (bulk bar hides).
super_admin.bulk_visibility_change: PASS - bulk-visibility-select shows KM Bangalore / KM Thrissur / KM Kollam / All offices for super admin; choosing 'All offices' updated and cleared selection.
super_admin.bulk_delete_cancel: PASS - Cancel closes dialog, selection preserved, bulk bar still visible.
super_admin.bulk_delete_confirm: PASS - Confirmed delete removed all 3 ZZ students from list (table-empty state after re-filter).
super_admin.bulk_clear_btn: PASS - clears selection and hides bulk bar.

office_admin_KM_BLR.selection_works: PASS - 31 card checkboxes visible; bulk bar appears on selection.
office_admin_KM_BLR.visibility_options_restricted: PASS - bulk-visibility-select shows ONLY ['All offices', 'My office'] (no KM_TCR / KM_KMLY).

staff_KM_BLR.no_students_access: PASS - /students is gated at route level for staff; toast 'You don't have access to this page anymore.' shown and staff redirected to /overview. Consequently no selection checkboxes and no bulk bar exist (requirement satisfied). Note: sidebar still displays 'Students' entry for staff even though route is denied - minor UX inconsistency, out of scope for this feature.

critical_code_review_comments: Students.jsx line 690 Select onValueChange fires runBulk immediately on any change; because the Select is uncontrolled (no value prop), it does trigger for user selections which is fine, but there is no visual busy indicator on the trigger while bulkBusy is true (only disabled). Consider adding a spinner in the trigger. Minor.

StudentCard.jsx uses an outer <Link> and stops propagation on the checkbox span. Works correctly, but placing an interactive element inside an <a> is an a11y concern (nested interactive elements). Consider restructuring so the checkbox lives outside the anchor, or convert the card wrapper to onClick + role=link.

Office admin/staff seed accounts (blr1@finflow.com, staff.blr@kmfoundation.online) were soft-deleted at start of this run. There is no idempotent re-seed for them (only super admin auto-re-seeds). Had to re-create via POST /api/users. Recommend adding an idempotent seeding step for the documented test accounts to reduce test flake.
test_credentials: Used the three credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md exactly. Recreated blr1@finflow.com and staff.blr@kmfoundation.online via super admin POST /api/users because they had been soft-removed by prior tests.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 disposable students (ZZ_TestA/B/C) via the Bulk upload dialog; all 3 were deleted at the end of the test via the very bulk-delete flow under test. No lingering test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The office_admin (blr1@finflow.com) and staff (staff.blr@kmfoundation.online) accounts had been removed and were recreated during this run. If a future run finds 'This account has been removed' on login, re-create them via super admin (POST /api/users) using the payloads documented in test_credentials.md. Students bulk-action UI (selection, floating bar, status/visibility/delete, role gating) all pass; no regressions.
